bib.title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-World APIs

question: How can open-source LLMs be given strong tool-use ability over thousands of real-world APIs, including multi-tool instructions?
hypothesis: Scaling the number and diversity of instructions and unique tools in the training data lets the fine-tuned model generalize to unseen instructions and APIs.
contributions: ToolBench, an instruction-tuning dataset built automatically with ChatGPT over 16,464 RapidAPI APIs
DFSDT, a depth-first search-based decision tree reasoning strategy
ToolEval, an automatic ChatGPT-based evaluator (pass rate, win rate)
ToolLLaMA (LLaMA-2 7B fine-tuned on ToolBench) and a neural API retriever

method.summary: ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo-16k) generates instructions over sampled RapidAPI APIs and annotates solution paths with real API calls using DFSDT; LLaMA-2 7B is fine-tuned on the 126,486 passing pairs, and a Sentence-BERT retriever picks APIs. Evaluated with ChatGPT-based ToolEval on held-out instructions/tools/categories and on APIBench.
method.task: tool use / API calling instruction tuning

datasets.name: ToolBench (RapidAPI)
datasets.size: 126,486 (instruction, solution path) pairs; nearly 200k (instruction, relevant API) pairs: 87,413 I1, 84,815 I2, 25,251 I3; 3,451 tools, 16,464 APIs, 49 categories; 469,585 real API calls
datasets.split: train/dev/test with Inst., Tool and Cat. generalization levels; test and dev set sizes not stated
datasets.source: RapidAPI Hub, crawled; 10,853 tools / 53,190 APIs filtered to 3,451 / 16,464
datasets.preprocessing: Filtering by working status, response time and response quality; API responses compressed with ChatGPT-derived schemas, truncated to 1024 tokens.

datasets.name: APIBench (TorchHub, TensorHub, HuggingFace)
datasets.preprocessing: Each API treated as one function that selects an API, gives invocation code and describes output; no zero-shot setting evaluated.

other.training: relevant APIs as positives, a few sampled negatives, contrastive learning; hyperparameters not stated

training.objective: supervised fine-tuning on multi-round conversations in ChatGPT's input/output format; function field concatenated into the prompt

inference.samples: not stated for test runs; ToolEval draws >=4 predictions per solution path and majority votes
inference.prompting: Tool-GPT system prompt with function-call fields; oracle (ground-truth) APIs fed to each model except the Retriever row
inference.retrieval: top 5 APIs from the trained retriever for ToolLLaMA-DFSDT-Retriever

parameters.API response compression: over 1024 tokens compressed, then first 1024 tokens kept
parameters.DFSDT: pre-order traversal with no child sorting; diversity prompt on expansion; ReACT is the degraded case; ToolLLaMA used with either at inference

other.multi-tool sampling: 2-5 tools from same category/collection, at most 3 APIs each

metrics.name: Pass rate
metrics.definition: proportion of instructions successfully completed within limited budgets, judged by ChatGPT with majority vote over >=4 predictions (Pass/Fail/Unsure rules in A.5)

metrics.name: Win rate
metrics.definition: ChatGPT-judged preference vs ChatGPT-ReACT on paths both Pass or both Fail; ties split half to win and half to lose in Table 4

eval.protocol: ChatGPT automatic evaluator; agreement with human annotators 87.1% pass rate, 80.3% win rate on 300 test instructions per method; single run, no seeds or significance tests stated.

availability.weights: trained models publicly available per abstract

prompts.text: You are Tool-GPT, capable of utilizing numerous tools and functions to complete the given task. ... Let's Begin! Task description: {task_description}

prompts.purpose: diversity prompt for DFSDT child expansion
prompts.text: This is not the first time you try this task, all previous trails failed. ... you must generate actions that is different from all of them. Here are some previous actions candidates: {previous_candidate}
You will be provided with a tool, its description, all of the tool's available API functions ... creating 10 varied, innovative, and detailed user queries ...

evidence.quote: we use a learning rate of 5 × 10−5, a warmup ratio of 4 × 10−2, a total batch size of 64, a maximum sequence length of 8192, and use a position interpolation ratio of 2

limits: Evaluation by a ChatGPT judge; humans themselves disagree on which path is better (A.5).
Main comparison uses oracle APIs; test set sizes not stated; single runs, no seeds.
Test uses RapidAPI whose APIs change over time (cited as reason no fixed ground truth).
Authors concede 'there is still a long way to go for a fair evaluation of the tool-use domain'.
Gorilla cannot be run on ToolBench, so the comparison is one-directional.
Retriever beating oracle attributed by authors to similar replacement APIs; not tested further.
